reasoning_content: The corepack binary is in /opt/tools/node-v24.9.0/bin, but it's not in the PATH. Let's add node's bin to the PATH and use corepack.

action.command: export PATH="/opt/tools/node-v24.9.0/bin:$PATH"; corepack enable --install-directory /usr/local/bin 2>&1; COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT=0 corepack prepare yarn@4.13.0 --activate 2>&1; yarn --version
